entities.name: Szymon Bogumił Zug
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Szymon Bogumił Zug, born Simon Gottlieb Zug, and also known as Zugk, was a renowned Polish-German classicist architect and designer of gardens. Born in Merseburg in Saxony, he spent most of his life in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, where in 1768, he was ennobled.
